rv.q: Rarely has a man's moral decline been made so purely entertaining to watch.

Mellamphy’s assured, charismatic performance, and clear gift of gab, makes Tim an engaging and all too relatable anti-hero who finds his way to success via a series of questionably justified crimes and misdemeanors.
The performance is a physical as well as verbal feat.

cn.t: Michael Mellamphy impresses in this brutally clever one-man thriller told in rhyming verse, juggling multiple characters and challenging form with skill, though the ambitious poetic structure presents inherent hurdles.
